title: referenceEoS operation
description: A pure fluid from its REFERENCE (multiparameter Helmholtz-energy) equation of state, read from data/standards/parameters/Helmholtz/<equation>.dat (case-local constant/parameters/Helmholtz/ first). This is a propsDict operation under choupoProps, NOT a flowsheet unit (a flowsheet reaches the same equation through `pureFluids { <component> { method Helmholtz; equation <name>; } }`). Loading a record evaluates EVERY check value its publication prints (IAPWS-95: 81) at the printed precision and REFUSES the run on a single miss. Give exactly ONE mode block: state (T with p, or T with rho) or saturation (T, by the Maxwell criterion). A (T, p) state lists every density root of the isotherm with its branch; the stable one is taken unless `branch` names one. A (T, p) outside the publication's validity window is announced as an extrapolation. Diagnostics are SI per unit mass. Tutorial: tutorials/props/thermo/refEoS01_iapws95_verification.

state.title: Single state (T, p) or (T, rho)
state.description: One state. With p the density is SOLVED: every root of the isotherm is listed (below T_c one per branch; crossings inside the unstable region are counted and never taken). With rho the equation is evaluated directly. Reports rho, p, h, u, s, g, cp, cv, w and the fugacity coefficient phi.

branch.title: Root branch (with p only; may be metastable)

saturation.title: Saturation state
saturation.description: psat, rhoL, rhoV, h and s of both phases and hLV at T, by the Maxwell criterion (equal p and g), from the triple point to the critical point.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` -- optional; writes a one-row CSV of the state (12 significant digits, SI).
